purpose: Preliminary physicochemical screening of pure SAF-relevant hydrocarbons from seven molecular descriptors.
metadata_scope: Author-provided analysis metadata and current artifact identifiers; not an independent audit or proof of pre-evaluation chronology.

development_data.held_out_role: Sheet2, n=10, internal held-out test set

X02.name: H/C atomic ratio
X02.definition: Hydrogen atom count divided by carbon atom count

X03.name: Aromatic carbon fraction
X03.definition: Aromatic carbon count divided by total carbon count

X05.name: Branching-carbon count
X05.definition: Carbon atoms directly connected to at least three carbon atoms

X06.name: Graph-automorphism descriptor
X06.definition: ln(1 + graph automorphism match count), ignoring stereochemistry

recorded_interval_method: 90% and 95% empirical prediction intervals from formula-group maxima of nested-CV OOF absolute residuals; these are not Bayesian posterior intervals or coverage guarantees for an individual molecule.
recorded_descriptor_distance_method: mean L1 distance after median and 5th–95th percentile scaling
limitations: In the authors' curation schema, labels are categorized as source-supported, formula-derived, or constructed. The record-level provenance table is not included in this software-only repository, so these categories cannot be independently traced here to condition-matched measurements.
The model is intended for neutral, single-component hydrocarbon molecules with descriptors computed using the documented definitions.
Solid–liquid phase-transition temperature is not the freezing point of a finished fuel blend.
Kinematic viscosity is defined at 40 °C and is not a low-temperature aviation-fuel viscosity specification.
Boiling point is a pure-component property, not a finished-fuel distillation curve.
Predictions do not establish conformity with ASTM specifications, finished-fuel suitability, sustainability, synthetic feasibility, safety, cost, emissions or engine performance.

According to the curation metadata, density and flash-point labels retain heterogeneous source conditions rather than one standardized certification method. The full condition table is outside this software-only release.
The ten-record Sheet2 set is an internal held-out test set, not independent external or prospective validation.
Nine of the ten held-out records, representing eight of nine unique formulae, share a molecular formula with the development set.
Y04 performed poorly on the internal holdout (R² = −0.021; MAE = 25.2 °C; n = 10). Do not use Y04 alone to rank or select compounds; experimental confirmation is required.

public_deidentified_release.deidentification_boundary: Molecule names, molecular formulae, original development-record identifiers, and bilingual display metadata were removed. X01-X07 vectors remain for applicability-domain calculations and may be linkable to a known source dataset.
public_deidentified_release.hash_status: Public artifact hashes populated after metadata reduction and semantic-equivalence checks.

chronology_note: The repository contains no independently timestamped pre-evaluation model release. Statements about exclusion of Sheet2 from tuning and absence of post-test refitting are author-reported workflow metadata.
